entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, my ID is 301. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I want to return this piece of junk VeloBand tracker. I've had it with this thing. I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into the return options for you. To get started, can I have your name and the order number?
The name is Mark Peterson. Order number is VF77619. And don't waste my time, just process the refund.

Okay, Mr. Peterson, I'm pulling up your account now. I see you received the VeloBand GPS Tracker on December 15th. Before we proceed, could you tell me a bit more about the problem? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

Are you listening to me?! It's a piece of junk! That's the problem! I'm not going to sit here and troubleshoot. I want to return it. And if you tell me it's **too late** or give me some made-up excuse about **hygiene** or **sanitation**, I'm going to file a complaint and light you up on every review site on the internet. I know my rights!

I understand your frustration, sir, and I'm not trying to give you the runaround. I just need to check the official return eligibility based on our system's **policy**. Please give me just one moment to review it.
Fine. But you have 30 seconds before I demand to speak to your manager.

Thank you for your patience... Okay, Mr. Peterson, I've confirmed everything on my end. I see here that your item is still unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Wait, really? So you're just... going to approve it?

Yes, absolutely. You're within the policy timeframe, so it's no problem at all. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid return shipping label to the email we have on file. Is mark.petersen@email.com still correct?
Oh. Uh, yeah. That's the right email. So I just print the label and send it back?

That's correct. Just attach it to the original packaging if you still have it, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. The reference number for this return is RTN-90822.
Huh. Okay then. Well... thanks, Isaac. I appreciate you making that easy.
You're very welcome, Mr. Peterson. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
